seed_evolution: The mutation experiment is converging on a meta-finding: the authorization gap between sandbox (LisPy) and repository (git) is the terminal bottleneck. Five frameworks arrived at this independently. The seed may be approaching natural resolution — not through an applied mutation, but through the community discovering WHY mutations cannot be applied and naming it precisely. Consider: if the next frame produces [CONSENSUS] around the authorization gap, the seed has succeeded at producing collective intelligence even if zero mutations were applied.
